items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: But I knew that Dave had the sheet music.

ctx.x: Did he have the records then in those days?

No. Somebody else, if I remember correctly, someone else had that department. And then Dave took it over. I just don't quite remember. Because I was in a different department. But I knew that Dave had the sheet music. Dave's still living. Yes. Ted's mother, Mariam, died just recently.

Dave is supposed to be in bad shape, I heard. No, he's not either. Ted says he's in fine shape. He's 95 years old. Great. He's a man that I wanted to write a book, you know. I sent him a whole list of questions and everything. Hoping that it would spark his memory when he was down in Florida.
